mainEntity.name: What is the difference between traditional keyword optimization and topic clusters?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional keyword optimization often focuses on ranking individual pages for specific keywords, sometimes leading to fragmented content and keyword cannibalization. Topic cluster creation, however, takes a more holistic approach by organizing content around broad topics. Instead of optimizing separate pages for similar keywords, it links related articles to a central pillar page, demonstrating comprehensive expertise. This strategy shifts focus from individual keywords to topical authority, improving overall site-wide SEO performance and user experience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Traditional SEO targets individual keywords; topic clusters organize content around broad topics with a central pillar page to build topical authority and improve site-wide performance.
